metaDescription: Free online JWT Decoder. Decode JSON Web Tokens.
intro: Use our free online JWT Decoder tool. It parses JSON Web Tokens based on your inputs.
whatIs: The JWT Decoder is an online utility that parses JSON Web Tokens. It processes your JWT string and provides the readable JSON claims.
howToUse: Enter your JWT string into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like decoded header/payload.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate the readable JSON claims.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your JWT string. It instantly processes the data to output the readable JSON claims.
workedExample: For example: Decodes standard base64Url claims into `{ "sub": "123" }`.
resultInterpretation: The result represents the readable JSON claims. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing JWT string on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Decoding does NOT verify the signature. Do not trust decoded data blindly.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Can I edit the JWT?
faq.answer: You can, but it will invalidate the cryptographic signature.

faq.question: Is the JWT Decoder free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our JWT Decoder is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
